title.zh: 【Bithumb：受攻击的内部办公系统与交易平台独立运行，是否涉及客户仍待调查】
title.en: 【Bithumb：受攻击的内部办公系统与交易平台独立运行，是否涉及客户仍待调查】

current_state.zh: Bithumb disclosed that an external intrusion into its internal employee mobile system stole some personal information, and it is investigating whether customer data was affected; it says the system is separate from the trading platform and no crypto asset losses have been reported.
current_state.en: Bithumb disclosed that an external intrusion into its internal employee mobile system stole some personal information, and it is investigating whether customer data was affected; it says the system is separate from the trading platform and no crypto asset losses have been reported.
